# Unordered list indentation

## Indented by one under a paragraph

Write an adaptation that grants free usage to:
 - 501(c)(3)s
 - Educators and students
 - Security researchers
 - Start-ups earning under $1M USD

## Nested by two

- one
  - one point one
    - one point one point one
  - one point two
- two

## Nested by three and by one

- one
   - three in
- two
 - one in

## Siblings that drift

- first
 - second at one
- third

## Unordered under ordered

1. first
   - under ordered
     - under unordered under ordered
2. second
    - four in under ordered

## Ordered under unordered

- first
  1. ordered
     - unordered under ordered under unordered
- second

## In a quote

> - quoted
>   - nested quoted

## Nested on one line

- - inner
  - inner two

## Lazy

- item
lazy text
   - after lazy

## Code

```text
 - not a list
```

## Star and plus

* star
   * star three in

+ plus
  + plus two in

## Tabs

-	tab after the marker
 	- one and a tab before nested, two characters
-	tab after the marker
	- a tab before nested, one character

- dash
	- a tab before nested under spaces
